verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail's own marketing claims built-in AI summaries and automatic labeling/categorization of scanned mail. That is an AI-generated view of the user's mail data inside the product. Beyond per-item summaries and labels, nothing shows deeper insights or actionable suggestions. The claims are marketing-level only, with no detailed docs or hands-on confirmation. Missing for 10: AI-generated suggestions or recommended actions, insights across the user's mail data beyond per-item summaries, detailed first-party docs on how the AI features work, independent or hands-on corroboration.
